name: Dispatch

items.headline: The queue outside the depot
items.summary: Six hundred people, eleven jobs, one afternoon.
copy: By nine it had reached the corner.

items.headline: Water at the fifth floor
items.summary: Pressure is a scheduling problem wearing a plumbing costume.
copy: The pump runs for two hours a day.
Everyone on the fifth floor knows which two.
The rest of the building does not.

items.headline: The last licence clerk
items.summary: A counter that still works because one person remembers how.
copy: He has been at the counter since 1994.
He still keeps the paper register.

items.headline: A tanker, twice a week
items.summary: Four hundred rupees a week for what the pipe does not deliver.
copy: The tanker comes on Tuesdays and Fridays.
Nobody has asked the ward office why.
